Zone C (lower right): a pale card with three rows of small tags, each row struck through with a thin grey line — a mnemonic word list, a lettered source sheet, a symbolic notation page. Zone D (bottom full-width bar): a dark rounded conclusion strip with a teal check badge. Zone B (upper right): four virus cards standing in a row, each with a distinct emblem — a document sheet with a small face, a program gear with a bolt, a chained link between two files, and a globe with a crawling worm; the fourth card glows and is circled; a small magnifier hovers over it. Zone C (lower right): a pale card with three rows of small tags, each row struck through with a thin grey line — a document sheet, a two-in-one chain icon, a program gear. Zone D (bottom full-width bar): a warm rounded conclusion strip with a green check badge. Text on the image is Simplified Chinese only, in four short labels: "蠕虫", "网络病毒", "自我复制", "到处传" — bold brown rounded type on white rounded plates, each label no more than four characters. 16:9 landscape, high resolution, clean background.

items.prompt: Tech spec-card infographic, landscape, four-zone layout, dark charcoal background, cyan outlines with soft glow, metallic connector texture. Zone A (left, about 60% width): a workbench showing two connectors side by side on a mat — the left one is a broad, long parallel connector with two rows of many pins and a chunky metal shell; the right one is a small slim rectangular USB connector, visibly much shorter and narrower; a ruler runs along the bottom to compare their widths, and a magnifier hovers over the small connector; a screwdriver, a spare cable coil and a small parts tray complete the bench. Zone B (upper right): two USB version bars stacked — a short bar and a much longer bar beside it, with speed arrows of different lengths; below them three feature badges sit in a row (a plug being inserted sideways with a spark-free arrow, a lightning flash, and a driver-disc with a cross over it); a small label plate sits under each bar. Zone C (lower right): a pale card with three rows of small tags, each row ticked instead of crossed — a speed comparison, a plug-and-play arrow, and a driver disc. Zone D (bottom full-width bar): a dark rounded conclusion strip with a cyan check badge. Text on the image is Simplified Chinese only, in four short labels: "USB", "体积小", "热插拔", "速度快" — bold sans-serif on small dark rounded plates, each label no more than four characters. 16:9 landscape, high resolution, clean background.

items.prompt: Flat icon-style illustration, landscape, four-zone layout, soft warm grey background, rounded icons, tidy grid, warm tones. Zone B (upper right): a four-cell cabinet where each cell holds one file-type icon with a matching extension plate — a lined text page, a speaker with a wave, a framed picture and a film strip with a play triangle; the lined-page cell glows and is ticked; small arrows show each file dropping into its matching cell. Zone C (lower right): a pale card with three rows of small extension plates, each row struck through with a thin grey line — two audio plates, two image plates and two video plates. Zone D (bottom full-width bar): a soft grey rounded conclusion strip with a green check badge.
